scope: Reviewed account/email recovery claims only; not full six-source consolidation.

rows.requirement: Before any approved unlinking record independently reviewed loss of all access and exhausted authorized recovery routes. Distinguish original-account access, email unlinking and new-account linkage; repositories/permissions/profile remain with the old identity.
rows.negative_test: Unlinked email or new account cannot pass original-account recovery or mark 2FA disabled.

rows.requirement: Record approved mailbox control and recipient scope without committing actual addresses. Primary/backup selection and default all-verified fallback determine reset/OTP recipients; observed setting alone is not delivery.
rows.negative_test: A specifically selected backup cannot imply OTP delivery to all addresses; absent explicit selection cannot silently exclude other verified addresses.

rows.requirement: Bind timestamp and freshness to token type: reset link three hours and ordinary verification link 24 hours. Unlink/OTP expiry not supplied remains unknown. Never record secret token values in committed evidence.
rows.negative_test: A four-hour reset cannot pass using a 24-hour verification threshold; unknown unlink expiry cannot be fabricated as three or 24 hours.

rows.requirement: Separate links sent to all addresses, chosen mailbox link activation, final confirmation and observed resulting linkage. Optional new-account association is distinct and requires its own authorization/evidence.
rows.negative_test: Link dispatch cannot prove every email removed; confirmation for one mailbox cannot certify all-address unlinking.

rows.requirement: Distinguish deletion billing termination from locked-email unlinking, which may require support cancellation or sponsorship migration. File exact user-authorized support work separately; request submission is not external acceptance.
rows.negative_test: Unlinking cannot inherit deletion's immediate billing termination or certify sponsorship migration.

limitations: Negative-test entries are specifications, not implemented or executed tests.
No credentials, tokens, addresses or actual private assessment details recorded.
No recovery, unlinking, billing changes, support messages, native activation or rights clearance.
